fieldValues.title: Slow test gates get skipped, and quality falls
fieldValues.statement: The people and agents who build SRS tools rely on test gates to keep quality. When a gate takes too long, it is skipped, run partially or waited out, and broken work gets through or stalls: srs-web's end-to-end job takes about 8 minutes on a green run, and on 2026-10-30 one broken page made 30 tests each wait out a 60-second timeout twice, so the job was cancelled at 15 minutes with no report. Gate speed is part of quality, not separate from it.
